note: Entries whose `wikidataId` deliberately differs from the item their cited Wikipedia article resolves to. `wikidata.mjs verify` treats a listed entry as reviewed and exits 0; an unlisted mismatch fails. Every line here was checked against the Wikidata label, and the reason is the same one in every case: an English Wikipedia article is often broader than the thing this site records (FRICTION-LOG A7 — one item per family, not per model).

exceptions.glock-17: Q172172 is 'Glock 17 — semi-automatic pistol'. The cited article 'Glock' resolves to Q739882, the pistol brand, which covers the whole series.
exceptions.glock: Q702135 is 'Glock Ges.m.b.H. — Austrian weapons manufacturing company'. The cited article resolves to Q739882, the brand rather than the company.
exceptions.5-56x45mm-nato: Q238456 is '5.56×45mm NATO — intermediate firearms cartridge'. This entry cites the M16 rifle article because that is where its sourced figures come from, not because the article is about the cartridge.
exceptions.winchester-model-1873: No id, deliberately. The cited article 'Winchester rifle' resolves to Q1570235, which is the whole lever-action series; no free article covers the 1873 alone, and a series id on a model entry is a wrong join.
exceptions.izhmash: No id, deliberately. Izhmash and Kalashnikov Concern share Q7427495, so recording it here would duplicate the successor company's key.
exceptions.guide-lamp: No id, deliberately. Guide Lamp was a General Motors division dissolved in 1984 and has no Wikidata item of its own; the cited article 'Inteva Products' resolves to Q6057490, the modern successor company, which is a different legal entity from the one that built the M3. Escalated by the authoring agent rather than edited by it, per PLAYBOOK.md rule 2.
exceptions.kongsberg-vapenfabrikk: Q1603219 is 'Kongsberg Vapenfabrikk — Norwegian arms factory founded 1814'. The cited article 'Kongsberg Gruppen' resolves to Q1770909, the modern successor group; the factory that made the Krag-Jorgensen is the predecessor, not the group. Escalated by the authoring agent, not edited by it.
exceptions.as-val: No id, deliberately. Q118737325 covers 'AS Val and VSS Vintorez' jointly, and the cited article is about both arms; a joint id on a single-model entry is a wrong join, the same case as the PK family (FRICTION-LOG A7). Escalated by the authoring agent, not edited by it.
exceptions.ar57-llc: No id, deliberately. Q4653537 is the AR-57 rifle, not AR57 LLC the company that makes it; the maker's only free source is the article about its product. Recording the rifle's id on the manufacturer would be a wrong join. Left out by the authoring agent, not edited by it.
exceptions.industrias-trejo: No id, deliberately. Q7837935 is the Trejo pistol, not Industrias Trejo the company; no Wikidata item covers the firm itself, and its only free source is the article about the pistol series. Left out by the authoring agent, not edited by it.
